strategy_family: BTC-to-altcoin lead/lag prediction with strict non-overlapping out-of-sample signals
hypothesis: Lagged BTC returns may contain incremental predictive information for subsequent altcoin returns; any signal must be generated only from completed BTC observations and evaluated on strictly non-overlapping out-of-sample periods.

primary_evidence.source: Jia, Wu, Yan, Yin (2019/2023), A Seesaw Effect in the Cryptocurrency Market
primary_evidence.finding: Reports cross-predictability among major cryptocurrencies, with large cryptocurrencies including Bitcoin predicting other coins; this supports testing a BTC-to-alt lead-lag mechanism but does not establish profitability for this constrained implementation.

primary_evidence.source: Wen, Bouri, Xu, Zhao (2022), Intraday Return Predictability in the Cryptocurrency Markets
primary_evidence.finding: Reports time-dependent momentum/reversal predictability in actively traded cryptocurrencies; used only as mechanism context, not as proof for this exact small-account strategy.

preregistered_rules.signal: Use completed daily BTC candles only. At each decision date, fit a fixed simple lag map from BTC return to each eligible altcoin using only the development/training history available before that date; select at most one alt with positive predicted next-period return. No overlapping training/test labels and no reuse of future observations.
preregistered_rules.execution: Next-open fill; one open position maximum; long/cash only; DCA=0; pessimistic intrabar ordering; adverse gap handling.

constraints.exchange_filters: current public minimum-notional and quantity filters required

preregistered_rules.validation: Development segment, chronological validation folds, cost stress, multiple-testing correction, signal-economics screen, and one sealed final segment only after all admission gates pass; no exhaustive parameter tuning.

data_window: Not executed. Repository search did not expose a reproducible historical OHLCV dataset/report set on main, and the research environment could not retrieve public Binance market-data files directly. Current authoritative Binance documentation confirms public market-data infrastructure exists, but no credentials were used and no substitute dataset was fabricated.
reason: The required public historical data could not be reproduced in this run, so development/validation folds and the sealed final were not opened. This is a data-integrity block, not evidence that the strategy is unprofitable.
benchmark: 30-day long/cash TSMOM remains the admitted historical benchmark, pending forward paper evidence.
next_distinct_queue_item: Trend plus funding-crowding filter using only settled funding known at decision time, provided exact public funding history and current minimum filters can be reproduced without credentials.
